_: Which figures results/table.md carries, and what each one is asking.
A view re-orders and re-colours the section's rows; it never re-measures. `sort` is the
label order the bars are grouped in, so the last label named is the one that varies
inside each block — that is the comparison the block makes. `colour` is what the eye
groups by across the whole figure. `scatter: false` on a view whose sort is the point of
it, because a point's position is its two metrics and re-ordering moves nothing: only
colour tells two scatters apart, so only the three single-label views draw one.
Delete a view to stop drawing it. Nothing else reads this file.
